title: VaultBrokerService
responsibility: Queues Credential Vault requests, checks phone-signed approvals against the bound recipe, runner and scope, and delivers each once.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.constructor.devices
inputs.description: Device repository that verifies phone proofs.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.constructor.audit
inputs.description: Journal for every request transition.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.constructor.now
inputs.description: Clock in Unix milliseconds; defaults to Date.now.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.create.input
inputs.description: Preflighted session request with recipe, scope, runner key and reason.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.create.uid
inputs.description: Kernel-verified OS user of the caller, or null when unknown.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.queue.proof
inputs.description: V1 proof for /v1/device/requests.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.decide.proof
inputs.description: V2 proof whose payload is the approve or deny decision.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.claim.ticket
inputs.description: Request id and receipt.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.claim.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must match the creator.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.status.ticket
inputs.description: Request id and receipt.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.status.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must match the creator.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.cancel.ticket
inputs.description: Request id and receipt.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.cancel.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must match the creator.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.delivered.ticket
inputs.description: Request id and receipt.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerService.delivered.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must match the creator.

inputs.name: vaultAuditFields.entry
inputs.description: A request the broker holds.

outputs.name: vaultRequestLimits
outputs.description: Offer window 120 s, delivery window 60 s and a queue of 16 live requests.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.create
outputs.description: Request id, one-time receipt, offer expiry and runner fingerprint.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.queue
outputs.description: Live pending requests as the phone shows them, with the recipe digest display and without the runner key.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.decide
outputs.description: denied, or approved with the proof held for one delivery.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.claim
outputs.description: The signed approval and the request; the request becomes delivered.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.status
outputs.description: Current request status, after expiring a lapsed request.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.cancel
outputs.description: canceled for a pending or approved request, otherwise its unchanged status.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerService.delivered
outputs.description: The delivered request, for issuing its lease.

outputs.name: vaultAuditFields
outputs.description: Request id, item, site, action, method, recipe digest and host.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 429 'The broker queue is full.' with 16 live requests.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'Use a fresh runner key for each request.' when the runner key was used before.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 500 'Refused a malformed audit record.' or a file-system error when the journal append fails.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 401 'Device is not enrolled.' when the proof's device id is not pinned.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 403 'The device role does not allow approvals.' for a recovery device.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 401 'Device proof is invalid or expired.' when the nonce was not issued to this device, was already used, is past its 30 s window, or the signature does not verify.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 400 'Invalid decision ...' when the payload is not a valid decision.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'Decision does not match a pending request.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'The decision is for another runner or recipe.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'The approval scope differs from the request; approve again.' when method, mode, account, session, action, host or lease length differ.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'Only a device grant approval carries no sealed credential.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'Approval expiry is outside the delivery window.' when it is past or more than 60 s ahead or after the offer expiry.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 404 'Request not found.' when the request id is unknown, the caller's uid differs from the creator's, or the receipt does not match.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'Approval is unavailable.' when the request is not approved, including after a delivery or expiry.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'The request was not delivered.'
